spec.title: Publish apps/kanban to GitHub Packages
spec.context:
Currently there is no way to install claude-kanban into other repositories. The package is not published to any registry. Users cannot run npx to set up kanban in their projects. This blocks adoption and distribution of the kanban tooling to other codebases.
GitHub Packages provides free private npm-compatible distribution using existing GitHub authentication and repository permissions.

scope.in-scope: - Configure apps/kanban package.json for GitHub Packages publishing - Update PACKAGE_NAME constant in install.cjs - Add kanban:publish script to root package.json - Create .npmrc.template showing authentication setup
scope.out-of-scope: - CI/CD automation for publishing (manual publish via script) - Public npm registry publishing - Version bumping automation

spec.requirements: - FR1: Package name shall be "@mattfletcher94/claudeban" - FR2: publishConfig.registry shall point to "https://npm.pkg.github.com" - FR3: repository.url shall be "https://github.com/mattfletcher94/claudeban" - FR4: prepublishOnly script shall run the build before publish - FR5: Root package.json shall have "kanban:publish" script - FR6: PACKAGE_NAME in install.cjs shall reflect "@mattfletcher94/claudeban" - FR7: Help text shall show correct npx command - FR8: .npmrc.template shall document authentication setup for users

files.file: Update name, repository.url, add publishConfig and prepublishOnly script
Template showing GitHub Packages authentication configuration

patterns.pattern: Root scripts use pnpm --filter to target specific packages. Reference: package.json:12-15 (kanban:build, vscode:watch, etc.)

research.product: distribution/github-packages: Stub doc confirming intent to use GitHub Packages for private npm distribution with existing GitHub auth.
research.engineering: No existing engineering docs for npm publishing. This is new capability.
research.codebase: - apps/kanban/package.json already has correct files array ["bin", "dist"] - Build pipeline exists: build, build:tools, build:scripts, build:content - install.cjs uses PACKAGE_NAME constant at line 13, referenced in help text - Repository URL currently incorrect (claude-kanban vs claudeban)
research.pitfalls: - GitHub Packages requires scoped package names matching repo owner - Users must configure ~/.npmrc with PAT for authentication - pnpm publish requires running from package directory or using --filter

spec.constraints: - Package must remain private (only accessible to those with GitHub repo access) - Must use existing pnpm workspace patterns for consistency

dependencies.internal: apps/kanban build pipeline must complete successfully before publish

risks.risk: Users unfamiliar with GitHub Packages auth may struggle to configure access
